barrow_binding_changes: 2 heights over the character's ground, not y=0
3 rig spin absolute over knight.gd's seat (rig mode)
4 blade proxy on the weapon bone

channel.held: stays up while the key/button is held, then spin-down

glossary.ARC_LIGHT_*: the source's light at the tip; in the Barrow a ground pool of that range and colour
glossary.CORE_* / BODY_*: two ribbon layers: the core (additive, emissive, the newest CORE_AGE_FRAC of the arc) and the body (alpha-mixed, darkening, the older part); alphas per inner/outer edge
glossary.GUST_*: Poisson gusts (rate 8-14 /s by channel weight): each surges the core x1.3-1.7 (decay tau) and sheds 2-4 quanta off the apex
glossary.ONSET_*: a ring of quanta thrown out once as the spin rises (from 0.60 to 1.05 x R_ENGAGE)
glossary.RAMP_*: the ribbon colour ramp off the tint's hue (apex -> body -> tail)
glossary.RESIDUE_*: RecipientResidue: tinted puffs curling up off a struck target (contacts only)
glossary.R_ENGAGE: the engagement radius, 1.9 x standing height (measured off the native EoR frames); contacts, scuffs and scour live here
glossary.R_TRAIL: the source's blade-tip radius (its greatsword: shoulder 0.21 + arm 0.63 + blade 1.515 m); in clip mode the ribbon follows the REAL weapon head instead
glossary.SCOUR_*: FloorScour: neutral darkened ground marks laid per pass; persistent (the floor remembers); value tuned to the source's dark floor (venue-coupled)
glossary.SCUFF_*: ScuffPuff: NEUTRAL dust at R_ENGAGE on each blade pass (2 per revolution, w > 0.55), thrown along the sweep and dragged to a stop
glossary.SHED_*: ShedQuantum: tinted additive puffs off the apex (gusts) and off the dropped history on spin-down; size classes, life, drag tau, entrain = the fraction of the tip speed they inherit
glossary.SPARK_* / MAX_SPARKS: ContactSpark: tinted, at a contact with a target only (none in the Barrow)
glossary.SWEEP_Y / SWEEP_WOBBLE: the sweep plane height and its helical wobble (+/- sin(spin) x wobble x w)
glossary.TAPER_MIN_FRAC: the oldest end of the arc narrows to this fraction of the band
glossary.TRAIL_INNER_FRAC, XSEC_*: the ribbon covers the outer ~20 % of the blade; XSEC breathes that inner edge between XSEC_MIN and XSEC_MAX
glossary.TRAIL_SAMPLES / trail window: blade history: 10 samples at 60 fps = 10/60 s (~150 deg at 900 deg/s): an ARC, never a closed ring
glossary.spin_up_s / spin_down_s: measured off the native EoR (two independent rates); the channel weight w ramps 0 -> 1 -> 0 at these
glossary.turn_rate_mul: the GD packet's turn rate while channelling (x0.35)

tint.name: original
tint.ramp_rule: set_element keeps the element's HUE only: apex = hsv(h + RAMP_APEX_DH, RAMP_APEX_SV), body = hsv(h + RAMP_BODY_DH, RAMP_BODY_SV), tail = hsv(h + RAMP_TAIL_DH, RAMP_TAIL_SV); red is given at hue 345 deg so the apex lands at 4 deg

weapon_tip_rule: the grip = the tip bone's origin; the head = the held weapon mesh's farthest vertex from that bone (a vertex belongs to the nearer of weapon_r / weapon_l), at bind, kept in the bone's local space and carried by the bone every frame; the ribbon spans grip.lerp(head, TRAIL_INNER_FRAC +/- the cross-section breathing) -> head
